Name: JP's Artdew Valley Vol I - Paintings (Environment)
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][color=#00ffff][size=6][u][center]Artdew Valley Vol I[/center][/u][/size][/color][/b]

[b][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]Because there's nothing better than covering all your walls with elegant paintings on a whim or simply because you like them—anything goes![/size][/color][/i][/b]



[/font][font=Georgia][b][size=4][i]This mod consists of 12 volumes so far, this being the first of them. This volume focuses on adding 30 paintings that contain different and beautiful pixel art-style environments. [/i][color=#ffff00](This volume alone adds 30 paintings, for a total of 90 in the three volumes of environment paintings, and 150 in total if all five volumes focused on paintings are counted.)[/color][/size]
[/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You can get all these paintings at [color=#00ff00]Robin's shop[/color] for a modest price of 500g each.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You will find 6 paintings available per day, on [color=#00ff00]Mondays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays[/color]. During that time, you will be able to obtain all 30 paintings available in this volume.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The paintings vary in size, although they are generally quite large, so be careful with the ceiling![/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=3]


[/size][color=#00ff00][size=4][b][i]That's it, I couldn't wait to get this over with, but here we are!!!!!! I hope you enjoy the mod.[/i][/b][/size][/color]



[b][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations
[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b][size=5][b][i]Spanish:[/i][/b] [/size][size=5][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/180180273-hayato2236/]Hayato2236[/url]. ¡Muchas Gracias![/size]

[color=#ff00ff]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color]

[size=4][b]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/b][/size]
